objective: Deliver, demonstrate, validate, package, and commit an installable repository-scoped council-flow Codex skill.
constraints: Use the connected repository; do not access or alter ACP, other projects, existing skill installations, or global Codex configuration.
No external deployment, publication, paid backend, database, custom orchestration runtime, permission escalation, or Windows operations.
Manager coordinates and records evidence; Workers alone implement application and project code.
Only one Worker mutates this workspace at a time.
Tester and Reviewer are separate fresh native agents and cannot repair implementation.
Preserve mandatory acceptance criteria through repairs; changes in scope or consequential authority belong to Owner.
Use inherited available model/provider configuration; do not invent model IDs or configuration keys.
Use native delegation; never simulate role sessions.
A skill is an instruction workflow, not an OS security boundary.
Continue useful authorized repairs; stop identical failures without a new remedy.
acceptance: P01: Official-format .agents/skills/council-flow/SKILL.md has valid name and description, concise operational instructions, explicit $council-flow activation, and useful references.
P02: Include role, workflow, acceptance, and recovery references; purposefully populated native custom-agent definitions and optional metadata use verified official syntax.
P03: Native Planner and approved external-plan modes work as instructions; external mode never claims to invoke an external ChatGPT conversation.
P04: Separate request/result types preserve task identity, objective, scope, requirements, immutable acceptance, status, evidence, findings, repair decisions, and disposition.
P05: Actual native Codex discovery and explicit invocation are observed. Path placement, frontmatter validation, or manually reading a copied prompt do not establish this.
P06: Produce a valid deliberately incomplete offline receipt-calculator fixture with at least one genuinely failing behavioral test; retain reproducible baseline evidence.

P07: Through the newly invoked workflow, a real Planner defines the demo contract before implementation; parent Manager assigns a fresh Worker; separate Tester verifies; separate Reviewer evaluates; Planner performs the final objective check.

P08: Finished receipt_calculator.py accepts multiple entries, quantity and unit price, computes Decimal-safe line and grand totals, rejects negative quantity and invalid prices, formats rupiah, and needs no network.
P09: Executable behavioral tests and an actual user-facing demonstration run successfully against the final application, including the rice/onions Rp103,000 example.
P10: A mandatory failing verification is explicitly rejected and triggers corrective work or a blocked disposition; necessary repair uses a fresh Worker.
P11: Compact validation addresses V01–V14, clearly separating live runtime, static inspection, failures, and UNVERIFIED capabilities.

P12: Durable reports contain actual native role/session identifiers available to the Manager, contracts, changed files, commands, exit results/output, independent findings, repair decisions, final check, and unsupported capabilities.

P13: README and RELEASE explain installation, exact invocation, demonstration, verification, boundaries, and limitations; provide the complete skill, custom agents, and a standard-tool distributable ZIP.
P14: Commit the completed in-repository deliverables to the current repository; preserve the initial repository assets and leave no unauthorized modifications.
P15: Owner report begins COMPLETE only when every Definition-of-Done condition is observed. Any unverified required capability requires PARTIAL with its precise blocker.
